# Fresh-event lane: October 11–15, 2026

Prepared four complete candidate cards and three unresolved leads. Candidates cover Trump’s October 11 announcement of an energy ceasefire, the same-day temporary order on taxpayer-funded ads, the October 12 East Potomac tree-cutting order, and the October 14 Supreme Court stay involving FCC political-ad rates.

Each card has short, medium, and long copy within requested bounds; exact source URLs; attribution and uncertainty; provisional category/tags; and a duplicate-review note. The cards distinguish announcements from implementation, interim orders from final merits decisions, and allegations from findings.

Unresolved leads cover the Oct 13 Alaska visit’s reported pardon and gas-purchase announcements (official action records and terms not yet checked), the Oct 15 ballroom donor investigation (underlying commitments were chiefly from 2025, so the publication date is not a new contribution), and a scheduled AI task-force meeting (the retrieved report did not confirm it convened or acted).

The frozen `trump_entries.jsonl` export contains 7,143 entries. A bounded full-corpus title/date and event-phrase screen found no matching event; older broadly related entries were event-distinct. Existing candidate-like external JSONL artifacts were inventoried and prior fresh-event outputs checked. This is a lexical screen, not a semantic or exhaustive guarantee.

No canonical data, frozen export, Neon, prior lane, or other worker output was changed. Only files in this directory were created. Validation details and counts are in `validation-report.json`.
